head: Monochrome Lab: a black and white camera app for iPhone
dek: Monochrome Lab is a $9.99 black and white camera app for iPhone that shows its looks live before you take the photo, then lets you edit without losing the original. It was #50 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 19 November.
details: It shoots JPEG or RAW, with an Auto mode and a Manual mode for shutter speed and a maximum ISO, and a level, grid and Fibonacci overlay for framing; switching lenses keeps your crop. Edits include exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, grain, vignette, toning and glow, plus crop and perspective fixes, and you can edit photos already in your library and export them at full resolution. It's made by Tony Shepherd, came out on 18 November and needs iOS 17.
where: iPhone, iOS 17 or later, $9.99 once (US price)
means: If you like black and white photos, you see the final look while you frame the shot instead of converting it afterwards.
todo: Nothing to do; it's a one-off purchase if you want it.
thumb_words: BLACK AND WHITE CAMERA FOR IPHONE
